objectives: Aplicar un método de 4 pasos a Complete the Words.
Reconocer terminaciones y prefijos para deducir letras.
Aprender 10 palabras de la Academic Word List (sublista 1).

words: to examine something carefully in order to understand it
Researchers analyse the data before drawing conclusions.
a way of dealing with a problem or task
Her approach to studying is very systematic.
His research area is renewable energy.
to judge the quality or amount of something
Teachers assess students with projects and exams.
to accept something as true without proof
Do not assume that the first answer is correct.
the power or right to give orders; an expert source
The city authorities approved the new bike lanes.
able to be used or obtained
The software is available to all students.
Exercise has many benefits for concentration.
Entropy is a difficult concept in physics.
always behaving or happening in the same way; compatible
The results were consistent across all experiments.

practice.title: Complete the Words · Texto A (café)
practice.intro: Escribe **solo las letras que faltan**. Dispones de ~3 minutos.

items.q: Completa las palabras (escribe solo las letras que faltan).
items.text: Coffee is one of the most {{wid|ely}} {{consu|med}} drinks in the world. Its {{ori|gin}} is usually traced to Ethiopia, where farmers first noticed the {{stimul|ating}} effect of the berries. Over several {{centu|ries}}, the plant spread to Arabia and later to Europe. Today, millions of people depend on coffee {{produc|tion}} for their income, and climate change is becoming a {{ser|ious}} {{thr|eat}} to the crop.
items.explain: Pista: wid-ely (adverbio antes de un participio), consu-med (participio pasivo), stimul-ating (adjetivo de -ate), centu-ries (plural de century), produc-tion (sustantivo tras «coffee»), ser-ious y thr-eat (adjetivo + sustantivo).

practice.title: Complete the Words · Texto B (ciudades y bicicletas)

items.q: Completa las palabras (escribe solo las letras que faltan).
items.text: Many cities are {{encour|aging}} {{resid|ents}} to use bicycles instead of cars. Cycling reduces traffic {{conges|tion}} and air {{pollu|tion}}, and it {{impr|oves}} public health. However, cyclists need safe {{infrastr|ucture}}, such as {{prot|ected}} lanes and secure parking. Without these {{facil|ities}}, many people feel that riding a bicycle is too dangerous.
items.explain: Pista: «are encouraging» (presente continuo), «residents» (plural), congestion/pollution (sustantivos en -tion), «it improves» (3ª persona), «protected lanes» (participio como adjetivo), «these facilities» (plural de facility).

quiz.explain: un- (no) + predict + -able (que se puede) = que no se puede predecir.

quiz.q: The company's rapid ______ surprised its competitors. (expand)
quiz.explain: Tras un adjetivo (rapid) y un posesivo falta un sustantivo: expansion.

quiz.q: Each of the researchers ______ a notebook during the field trip.
quiz.explain: «Each of» + sustantivo plural lleva verbo singular: carries.

quiz.q: Which word forms a natural collocation with "research"?
quiz.explain: conduct research es la colocación académica estándar (también carry out research).

quiz.q: The ending "-ment" usually signals which part of speech?
